title: Master One-Page Buildout Plan

canonical_node.axiom: Each article should become one canonical HTML page with invisible machine-readable layer markers and a merged manifest driving the topbar and page structure.
definitions: one_page_html_manifest.json: merged output of site_inventory.json and paper_metric_manifest.json
reader-layer markers: invisible HTML comments delimiting sections for scripts and Codex
reader layers: college, easy, academic, proof, math, source, audit, falsification, qa, metadata
site_inventory.json: owns page slug, series order, prev/next, file paths, topbar presence, layer source paths, HTML marker positions
paper_metric_manifest.json: owns proof scores, claim counts, law/variable activation, coherence scores, graph metrics, reading difficulty, audit/falsification status
derivation: The plan identifies best current source pieces for page body, topbar, variable spec, and one-page layer protocol.
It defines a two-input manifest system: site_inventory.json + paper_metric_manifest.json = one_page_html_manifest.json.
It specifies the one-page rule: each article becomes one canonical HTML page with invisible layer markers.
It lists reader layers and expanded variables to add to the manifest.
It provides build order and existing tools to reuse.
It sets guardrails to prevent overreach.
canonical_node.action: Implement the exporter, site inventory builder, and merger scripts, then apply the one-page manifest and reader-layer markers to a pilot page before full-site conversion.
boundary: Does not specify exact implementation details of the scripts.
Does not define the full schema of the manifests.
Does not provide proof of the claims mentioned.
Does not mandate which variables must appear in the visible topbar.
Does not resolve the missing apply_reader_mode_baseline.py status.
test: Pilot page passes Playwright visual checks on desktop and mobile.
Merged manifest correctly drives topbar and layer markers.
Guardrails are respected: no HTML edits by Paper Intelligence, no giant Excel parsing, no full-site conversion before pilot passes.

dg_protocol.dg2_new_capability: Enables a unified one-page HTML manifest system with reader-layer markers and expanded topbar variables, improving site consistency and machine readability.
dg_protocol.dg3_preserved_floor: Preserves existing site structure and source assets; does not delete separate easy/academic assets; keeps original/college page body visible.
dg_protocol.dg4_collapse_if_removed: Without this plan, the site lacks a standardized one-page manifest and reader-layer system, leading to inconsistent page structures and harder automation.

classification.recommended_atom_action: adopt as planning directive; do not treat as proof of any underlying claims

overstatement_risks: Treating the three-body solution or J-space claims as proven when they are only seeds.
Assuming the manifest system will work without testing.
Assuming all listed tools exist and function as described.
kill_conditions: If the pilot fails visual checks or manifest merge breaks.
If guardrails are violated (e.g., Paper Intelligence edits HTML).
If the missing apply_reader_mode_baseline.py is required and not found.
risk.lean_target: Implement the exporter and merger scripts, run pilot on revolution-of-truth, and validate with Playwright.

plain_summary: This document is a buildout plan for converting articles into one-page HTML with a merged manifest and reader-layer markers. It is a planning document, not a proof of any scientific claims. It should be used as a directive for implementation, with caution not to overstate the status of the claim seeds.
